tools.name: list_node_vocabulary
tools.description: Node types the Strategy Builder supports (indicators, conditions, orders, filters, exits...) with their parameters, defaults and port counts. Pass category to shorten the list.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: Ready-made Strategy Builder strategies (id, name, description). Open one with get_template to see a complete, valid flow.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: One template as a flow in exactly the shape validate_flow and create_builder_link accept. Use it as a model or a starting point.

tools.name: validate_flow
tools.description: Checks a flow with the same engine the Strategy Builder uses. Returns errors (must fix) and warnings (review). Error codes: E201 loop, E202 no Start, E203 unreachable node, E204 unconnected input, E205 indicator wired straight into an order, E206 duplicate single-use node.

tools.name: create_builder_link
tools.description: Validates the flow and, if it has no errors, saves it and returns a aistrategyminer.com Strategy Builder URL that opens it on the canvas. A link expires 90 days after the same flow was first saved. The user backtests there and, with Pro, downloads the source to compile in MetaEditor.

tools.name: open_strategy_miner
tools.description: Returns an aistrategyminer.com link that opens the Strategy Miner (generator) with the given conditions already filled in: symbol, timeframe, direction, period, trial limit, minimum trades, seed, entry families, and optional realistic account and cost settings (spread_pips, commission, swap_long, sw

tools.name: get_miner_results
tools.description: Reads a result summary that a Pro user handed over with the Hand to AI button in the Strategy Miner results (id from the user). Hand to AI is Pro only: a trial run has no Hand to AI button, so a user who is not on Pro has no id to give. Returns the settings used, the realistic-cost settings if on, h

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "open_strategy_miner" is 2519 chars, far longer than this server's median (273). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Returns an aistrategyminer.com link that opens the Strategy Miner (generator) with the given conditions already filled in: symbol, timeframe, direction, period,…

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "open_strategy_miner" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
